info.name: Rider Incentive Journey Coupon Flow
info.description: Rider E2E: the rider dashboard creates a targeted offer (rule: OFFER#<code> in personTags), a Daily journey with one RideCompleted GTE 1 Coupons milestone, and a cohort-journey mapping, then assigns the rider. It checks that the dashboard rejects a Coins milestone and an unknown offer code. One auto ride completes the milestone. The rider then holds OFFER#<code> and AutoApplyOffer#<code> (profile customerTags), and the rider list, history and dashboard stats show the completed milestone with its offer code.
